Achievements

Audio

 Change number of side quests from 42 to 44.

Localization


 Corrected a line of Kress, replaced "ascension" by "transcendence" in the entext to match the voice.
 Corrected the load save/loaded text in Spanish from "¡partida guardada!" To"¡partida cargada!".
 Fix overlapping text (FP cost) in the ability screen [German].

Performance


 Add resolution options to game settings.

 Fix black screen occurring after entering the swamps.
 Fix game freezes when you click on second monitor in combat only.
 Fix issue that would break animation and VFX playback in battles.
 Fix soft lock when saving progress in the Arktan valley quest while in Arktanvalley.

Visuals


 Add missing feedback (SFX/VFX) when token transform is successful.
 Adjust text spacing globally.
 Dark mage bounding box on stance 1 adjusted.
 Fix dark shadow on Scorpio chests.
 Fix dd box size.Fix free explorer's death animation.

notes.title: Astria Ascending is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Steam users, ascend! 

This long wait finally rewarded. YES! Astria Ascending is released today on PC and console! 

Astria Ascending is a turn-based and gorgeous hand-drawn J-RPG developed with the help of genre veterans.

[previewyoutube=uLg4rS19d6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to start your adventure with Ulan and the fated Demigods. They are doomed to die while holding the fate of the world in their hands.

The world of Orcanon awaits!

notes.title: Advanced combat: dungeons & Astrae
notes.content:
3 days to go until the release! :D 

Learn more about the world of Orcanon and its explorable dungeons with this new trailer and discover the power of the Astrae linked to the zodiac signs! 

[previewyoutube=FwXj6wmAVpw;full][/previewyoutube]

In Astria Ascending there are 25 dungeons to explore with environmental puzzles to solve in order to progress.

But careful! These dungeons are inhabited and protected by powerful guardians called Astrae. 

Face these ancient creatures and restore balance in the world of Orcanon. 

As a reminder, the Astria Ascending's digital version will be out on September 30 while the physical version will be released on November 2.


The Digital Collector's Edition will be available on Steam when the game is released.

notes.title: Meet Dagmar!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/fa5e0f01c69e21e1bffe86b5433dda2817f66d30.png

Dagmar is a taciturn Arktan.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/e52adfb67361bf770fc1ce61db08a73cbf72f47b.jpg

Dagmar is a bit gruff. He doesn't like wasting time waiting around and he only speaks when he deems it necessary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/ec8631940ea5fe22d64be6a32e800960479ab7c4.png

Dagmar perfectly illustrates the attitude of the Arktan race, proud and dark.

The Arktans whose appearance is feline live in the city of Arsion, in the middle of the desert. 

They are proud to belong to their people and their temperament is sometimes fiery!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/f7ba3708c45a2deaecad7529aaa29eedd17e53e4.png

notes.title: Astria Ascending COMBAT MECHANICS
notes.content:
The official release of Astria Ascending is coming veeeery soon! We are SO excited (we hope you are too). 

September 30th is the date to mark in your calendars! 

Astria Ascending mixes RPG battles with a Focus Point system that rewards strategic gameplay. 

We've made for you a video detailing the basics of in-game combat. 
Check it out if you haven't seen it yet: 

[previewyoutube=4Aquuc8O5xI;full][/previewyoutube]
The turn-based fights in Astria Ascending are exciting and innovative as they feature a Focus Point system. 

This will allow you to increase the strength of the Demigods skills and strategically exploit enemies' weaknesses to take the upper hand in the fight.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/fa5e0f01c69e21e1bffe86b5433dda2817f66d30.png

Arpajo is Alassia's husband.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/496e8c73334846a77bfffed780cbda445c26d4d3.jpg

Arpajo is also a Meryo. He helped Alassia a lot in her researches and managed to seduce her. 

He is nonchalant and prone to joking around, which tends to annoy some of his comrades. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/ed70fe7e84dcd87258109fde6de2fe27e86373c8.png


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/f7ba3708c45a2deaecad7529aaa29eedd17e53e4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40171611/050ac1054f7e6af4824e85ff52c1ca8d50cb65a0.png

notes.title: Introducing the J-Ster
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We thought the time has come to introduce you to the J-Ster: a strategic hexagonal board game you'll discover in Astria Ascending! 

Want to become a J-Ster master? 


[previewyoutube=N7zdMYgNtis;full][/previewyoutube]

You will be invited to duels as you meet new people and as you progress in the game. Be careful with the rules given by the NPCs, you could lose your precious tokens on an unfortunate defeat! 

But the glory and the tokens will be yours if you win! Be strategic, steal your opponent’s tokens and become the best J-Ster player.

ReleaseAstria Ascending will be released this September 30 on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4/5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam, GoG, Epic).
